name: RS05
title: Redelings & Suchard (2005) model of insertions and deletions

citation.title: Joint Estimation of Alignment and Phylogeny.

args.name: logProb
args.description: The log insertion rate, also used as the deletion rate

args.name: meanLength
args.description: The mean indel length in alignment symbols; must be at least 1

args.name: tau
args.description: The probability of terminating after an alignment column

args.name: topology
args.description: The tree topology, normally supplied automatically

description:
Allows insertions and deletions of geometrically distributed lengths. Unlike RS07, the alignment model is the same on every branch and does not depend on branch lengths or branch-specific indel-rate multipliers.

The parameter logProb is the log insertion rate, also used as the deletion rate, rather than a log probability. Their combined event probability is x = 1-exp(-2*exp(logProb)); the gap-opening parameter is x/(1+x). The termination probability tau controls the sequence-length distribution.
